summary.content:
Today's selection covers 101 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 77 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google, Microsoft and OpenAI among 100 firms calling for better cyber defences
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Webinar: How Google Workspace breaches happen and what to do next
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Ars Technica, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 67 articles published in the last 24 hours
